capabilities.inputSchema: candidateIds; the router binds candidates and authoritative request conditions
capabilities.resultMeaning: Returns candidate-associated source facts or an explicit unknown result; it never asserts availability.

capabilities.name: CHECK_AVAILABILITY

capabilities.name: END_READ

capabilities.resultMeaning: Records the selection; it does not authorize or submit a booking.
importantConstraints: A selected offer must belong to the selected candidate.

Only Lunch Nigiri Gozen13 items

Indulge in our lunch-exclusive Omakase sushi course, featuring the day's recommended ingredients. This carefully crafted menu showcases the artisan's meticulous skill in sushi, complemented by a balanced selection of rolls, warm dishes, tamagoyaki, and soup. It's a satisfying yet accessible experience, making it perfect for first-time visitors. Enjoy a luxurious midday moment at Sushi Ginza!

ReserveSet menu details
JPY 6,000JPY4,999（Price including tax）per person

Omakase Nigiri Course18 items

Our standard omakase course is available for both lunch and dinner. It begins with seasonal appetizers, followed by eight carefully crafted sushi pieces, rice bowls, rolls, and soup, all designed to enhance your dining experience. We strive to provide satisfaction that exceeds the price, with a focus on each individual dish. This course is also recommended for meals with friends or small gatherings.

ReserveSet menu details
JPY 10,000JPY6,999（Price including tax）per person

Most popular

Omakase Premium Nigiri Course21 items

Experience an elevated omakase course that includes appetizers, exquisite dishes, and nine pieces of sashimi and nigiri. Each plate showcases seasonal flavors and the essence of our carefully selected ingredients, allowing you to fully appreciate the charm of our restaurant. This luxurious offering, which even includes dessert, is perfect for anniversaries and special occasions. Enjoy a refined moment in a tranquil setting.

ReserveSet menu details
JPY 12,000JPY8,999（Price including tax）per person

This is a vegan (vegetarian) omakase course crafted without any animal products, utilizing seasonal ingredients and traditional Japanese culinary techniques.
